title: Biomarkers in endometriosis
summary: In this study, both a patient group suffering from endometriosis and a control group will be recruited. Patients who will receive a laparoscopic surgery or have received one in the last 6 months due to the suspicion of endometriosis, for the clarification of other symptoms or in the case of an unfulfilled desire to have a child will be included. In this project, approx. 20 ml of blood will be collected twice (once preoperatively and once approx. 6-12 weeks postoperatively) and a representative tissue sample of the endometrium of the uterus will be taken once during the surgery. The material obtained will be examined to see which specific proteins are produced in the cells or which molecules are found in the blood.
